# Project

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A defined, bounded effort with a specific goal and completion criteria, undertaken over a limited timeframe.

## Scope note

Per the PARA method; distinguish from Area (ongoing, no end state) and from the Effort Cluster / Output Cluster structures used specifically for content-series work.
